root: ^This statue represents the visage of our monastery's founder. He was the first master that brought upon the very practices surrounding our beliefs.

cont: ^You hear a voice coming at first from the statue. You look towards its mouth, but soon the voice is resounding within your own head.
^"Head my words well, disciple. It is time for you to journey this world and restore the land from its calamity. Reconnect the times once seperated by the gods and enlighten the people around you."
